provenance: One person-sized object in doubleT_obstacle. The box was authored by hand at frame 181 and propagated over frames 165-200 by a constant-velocity fit of the detector's own track of that object (0.31 m per frame along +x, fit residual median 0.10 m, max 0.20 m); the tunnel is stationary in this recording, so the motion is the object's (a tracked ceiling fixture moves 0.001 m per frame). No frame is exhaustive: this records where one object is, not that the frames hold nothing else, and object identity as a person is the reviewer's judgement, not a measurement.
